explanation: Generated one physical eta electroproduction point at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, and phi*=90 deg using the eta defaults (EtaMAID, 6.535 GeV electron beam, recoil proton). The requested vcut=-0.1 is retained. However, eta/exclurad.F applies the vcut limit only when cutv > 1e-12, so this source treats -0.1 as no effective inelasticity cut, despite its documentation describing negative values as a direct-v cut.
